questions.q: Which uses more water to make?
questions.right: Yes! Animal products like milk usually use more water.
questions.wrong: Think about which one comes from an animal.

questions.q: What helps plants grow on this farm?
questions.right: Right! Plants need water to grow.
questions.wrong: Coins buy things, but water makes plants grow.

questions.q: If you save wheat instead of selling it, what can you do later?
questions.right: Correct! Saved wheat becomes porridge, flour or bread.
questions.wrong: Saved wheat can be very useful later.

questions.q: Which is usually better for water use?
questions.right: Yes! Plants usually use less water than animal products.
questions.wrong: Animals need food and water, too!
